CITY OF LA VERNE
  DEVELOPMENT REVIEW COMMITTEE
  ACTION MINUTES

Eric Scherer, Chair  City Hall
Cody Howing, City Engineer  3660 “D” Street
Danny Wu, Public Works  La Verne, CA 91750
  (909) 596-8706
  www.cityoflaverne.org

  Tuesday, July 1, 2025 – 9:00 a.m.
  City Hall Council Chambers
  3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750

Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Development Review Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Development Review Committee
with valuable information. Regular Meetings are held on the 1st Tuesday of every month. In
compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk’s
Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

The Council Chambers will be open to the public at 9:00 a.m. Materials related to an item on this
agenda, submitted to the Development Review Committee after distribution of the agenda packet,
are available for public inspection at the meeting or in the Community Development Department during
normal business hours.

  1. CALL TO ORDER

  Mr. Howing called the meeting to order at 9:01am.

  Voting members present: Cody Howing, Candice Bowcock, & Nicole Houston.

  Others present: Assistant Planner Valerie Chin, Fire Marshal Fred St. Ange, and
  Utility Supervisor Ralph Hernandez.

  2. PUBLIC COMMENT
 Development Review Committee Action Minutes – July 1, 2025
Page 2

  This is the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the Development Review
  Committee on items not listed in any other place on this agenda.

  California Law does not allow the Development Review Committee to take action in
  response to your statements at this meeting. Your concerns may be referred to
  staff or set for hearing at a later date.

  None

  3. APPROVAL OF ACTION MINUTES – May 6, 2025

  Mr. Howing was the only member present at the meeting on May 6, 2025, therefore,
  the minutes will be continued to the next DRC meeting for approval.

  4. PROJECT REVIEWS
  Note: Due to time constraints, discussion on these items will be limited to 30
  minutes each.

  PROJECT:  CONVERSION OF BUILDING TO LIVE-WORK UNITS
  CASE NO:  130-24PPR
  ADDRESS:  2478 ARROW HIGHWAY
  Project Planner:  Candice Bowcock, Principal Planner
  Valerie Chin, Assistant Planner
  Environmental:  Cat. Exempt

  Action: The applicant Jerry Tessier was present at the meeting.

  Ms. Chin presented the report.

  COA#23 language modified to read "Exterior doors and openings required by code
  shall remain readily accessible for emergency access. A minimum clear space must
  be maintained to the satisfaction of the Fire Marshal and the Building Official at the
  rear and side of the building to allow fire access. Prior to the issuance of Building
  permits, the applicant shall provide recorded documentation to the City Engineer."

  COA#28  "...and include the Police Department in the process if so required"

  COA #37 "... the number of organics carts shall increase to the satisfaction of the
  Public Works Department..."

  It was moved by Ms. Houston and seconded by Ms. Bowcock to approve Case No.
  130-24PPR. Motion carried 3-0.

  5. ADJOURNMENT

  2
 The meeting adjourned at 9:37 a.m. The next meeting of the Development Review
Committee is scheduled to be held on August 5, 2025 at 9:00 a.m. at City Hall,
3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750.

Respectfully submitted,

Natalie Hiatt, Administrative Secretary
